tagline: From a limestone arch down the James River gorge.
intro: Route 130 begins on US 11 at Natural Bridge, beside the Natural Bridge Hotel, and runs about six miles east to Glasgow, where the Maury meets the James. There it picks up US 501 and follows the rivers into the gorge the James has cut through the Blue Ridge.

Past the gorge, US 501 crosses the James into Bedford County and Route 130 goes on alone as Elon Road. It crosses the Pedlar River and slips through a gap in Tobacco Row Mountain to the hamlet of Elon.

moments.title: Natural Bridge
moments.text: A 215-foot limestone arch over Cedar Creek, the last of an old cave roof, with the initials G.W. cut 23 feet up that tour guides credit to a young George Washington.

moments.title: Glasgow
moments.text: On July 15, 1954, Balcony Falls, by the meeting of the Maury and the James, recorded 110 degrees, the highest temperature ever measured in Virginia.

moments.title: James River gorge
moments.text: The road keeps to the level of the river beside the railroad through the gorge, then climbs away for a winding crossing of the mountain near the Amherst line.
